Name: More Lively Meadowlands Farm
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][size=3][color=#fff2cc][i]﻿Makes the vanilla MeadowLands Farm more fancy with extra space, qql changes, tweaks and additions![/i][/color][/size][/center]
[size=3]
This map inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files#:~:text=The%20Recommended%20farm%20to%20play%20with%20Stardew%20Valley%20Expanded!%20Replaces%20the%20standard%20farm%20layout.]SVE Grandpha's Farm[/url] and DaisyNiko's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4635]Tiny Garden farm[/url], check them out if you want![/size]

[b][u][b][u][size=3]Features:[/size][/u][/b]
[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Completely overhauled Meadowlands Farm map![/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Custom starter giftbox items - (choose before starting new save file!)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]More space to explore - build, plant, dig in almost every tile and corner of the map![/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Ability to dig grass tiles[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Better fish catch pool - you won't get that much trash in farm from fishing anymore[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Forest forage spawning - now forage items will spawn randomly in farm[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Respawnable hardwood stumps - 1 stump respawns every day in right down corner of the map (6 stumps in total)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Option to add more grassy tiles instead of dirt[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]--------------------[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Secret Woods and Cindersap Forest passages - adds warps to Woods and Forest maps (the forest one will warp you to tile behing the big pink tree)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Grandpha's Shed passage warp if you have SVE installed - adds warp Grandpha's Shed map behind the small pond near farmhouse.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]------------------[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Extra river branch, lake and ponds[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Vanilla farmcave replacement - a small tidy farmcave in which you can plant crops, catch cave fish and even swim in a pool![/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Extra quarry farmcave in which ore and geode nodes will spawn[/size][/*]
[/list]
[center][b][size=3]Every option is toggleable  - don't want extra quarry cave or want to make farm more grassy? You can config all of it in my mod's config! (Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM mod [/url]for more convenient ingame config)[/size][/b][/center]
[left][/left]
[img]https://imgur.com/QoiZHAg.png[/img]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Starter Gift[/b] - Changes the stuff you get from starter gift box (will only work if you start fresh game - choose BEFORE creating new save file.)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Starter Giftbox items available:[/b] [/size][/*]
[/list][spoiler] 
﻿  [size=2]﻿- Farming - will give you 15 Parsnip Seeds and 1 Sprinkler
﻿  ﻿- Foraging -  will give you 10 Carrot seeds, 3 Field Snacks and 1 Forager's Hat
﻿  ﻿- Fishing -  will give you 1 CrabPot and 1 Training Rod
﻿  ﻿- Combating -  will give you 1 Wooden Blade and 3 Cherry Bombs
﻿  ﻿- Ranching -  will give you 20 Hay and 3 Cookies
﻿  ﻿- Floristing -  will give you 9 Tulip Seeds, 9 Jazz Seeds and 1 Fedora Hat
﻿  ﻿- Jojaing -  ???  [/size][/spoiler]
[size=2] [/size]
[size=2]-------------------[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Spawn Forest Forage[/b] - Makes forest forage items spawn in grassy tiles in farm.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]FarmCave Replacement[/b] - Replaces the vanilla farmcave (DISABLE IT if you use other mods that replace the farmcave!).[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Extra Quarry Cave[/b] - Adds custom extra farmcave near Grandpha's Shrine in which ore and geode nodes can spawn.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]SecretWoods Entrance [/b]- Adds warp to Secret Woods in down left corner of the farm map (you can also warp back from Woods to Farm).[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Cindersap Forest Entrance[/b] - Adds warp to Forest - will warp you to the forest map into the tile behind the big pink tree (you can also warp back from Forest  to Farm).[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]More Grassy Tiles[/b] - Adds more  more grassy tiles instead of dirt.[/size][/*]
[/list]-------------------
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Extra River Branch[/b] - Adds additional river branch with bridges.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Small Pond [/b]- Adds small pond near the farmhouse.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Water Trough[/b] - Adds small Water Trough near farmhouse, you can refill your watering can in it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Lake [/b]- Adds lake with waterfall in bottom right corner of the map.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Lake Dock[/b] - Adds small wooden dock at the bottom right lake.[/size][/*]
[/list]

[b][img]https://imgur.com/GqZYehL.png[/img][/b]
[size=2][color=#b6d7a8][b]Compatible[/b] [/color]with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, ect...
[b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible [/color][/b]with any recolors and retextures. 
[b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible[/color][/b] with mods that replace the FarmCave (but you'll need to disable my farmcave replacement in my mod's config!)
[b][color=#e06666]Not Compatible [/color][/b]with mods that change Meadowlands farm. [/size]

[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/lMF7LuG.png[/img][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url][/*]
[*][size=2](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Unzip "More Lively Meadowlands Farm 1.6" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[*]Enjoy.

[size=3][b]Bugs&Issues: [/b][/size][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]After disabling Water Through or FarmCave replacement - water tiles may remain visible (it will fix itself after you'll reload your game)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Sometimes forage items may spawn in weird places.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If you install on already existing save file - your farm may lack some debris around the areas my mod adds.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If you install on already existing save file - there can be bushes and other debris spawned in wrong places (in front of farmcave and other places. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes [/url]﻿mod to remove them)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If you install on already existing save file and already have some stuff placed in the down left corner of the map (buildings, crops, anything) - they be overlapped by extra river branch. Solution - disable "Extra River Branch" in my mod's config.[/size][/*]
[/list]
